ns2:course.label: Contemporary Issues in Leisure
ns2:course.description: (LEIST 329) Provides a capstone experience to encourage critical and creative thinking regarding knowledge students accrued from prior courses. The first eight weeks students will meet as a whole and focus on leisure concepts in general, and the second eight weeks students will focus on their specific concentration, (Sport Management, Tourism, or Community Recreation). Prerequisite: LEIS 120 and Senior status.
